sourceIntent: LAMBS doVehicleSuppress uses a supplied location, low-speed/minimum-distance/terrain/friendly checks, watch conversion and a delayed forced weapon action. Adopt report-support intent; do not copy random offsets or forced action.
finding: Routine CBE gunnery previously used current aimPos and object fire for all ranked reports up to15s old. Danger-only suppression did not provide routine report-support.
implementation: Reports older than3s within existing15s window now suppress the native believed position plus1m in ASL; very recent reports retain native object targeting. Recency is not proof of visual sight. Routine selection no longer reads hidden aimPos.

Ground vehicle only under30km/h and >=50m separation; refuse ongoing SUPPRESS, unrelated attack/assigned target and terrain occlusion. Existing ROE, native actor tasks, combined-ground reservation and friendly/civilian cone checks stay.

GroundFireReady optional sixth BOOL requires compatible actual-station nonexplosive shotBullet and >=20 loaded rounds. Raw same-frame station snapshots reevaluate this policy; fresh native check still precedes actual selected-muzzle acknowledgement/fire. Original32-query/16-weapon/8-muzzle limits unchanged.
Ground-relative doWatch and ASL doSuppressiveFire use the existing8s hold and callback. No new scheduler, setting, reveal or forced fire action.
cost: At most8 candidate terrain checks added; no measured performance claim. Existing station and cone-query bounds remain.

validation.packageSource: ba69c93b+dirty unsigned development, not later clean commit

limits: Engine controls suppression burst length.20 loaded-round threshold is not reserve/effect proof. No explosive suppression, building demolition or effect-based weapon selection added. Need terrain/low-ammo/moving/unrelated-target/combined-role/normalHC/performance verification.
